title: Scan Engine v2 — Implementation Specification
purpose: Defines the executable implementation of all 11 mandatory scans (PG-001 through PG-011 plus 4 analytical scans PG-AN-01 through PG-AN-04). Each scan is specified with exact algorithm, input schema, output schema, artifact storage path, dependency graph, performance targets, and error handling.

scan_engine_orchestrator.description: Orchestrates all scans in gate order, manages artifact storage, enforces dependency graph, aggregates results, and produces unified readiness classification per item.

exports.runPreFlight(items, options): Runs Gates -1 through 4 on provided items. Returns PreFlightResult.
exports.runGate(gateId, items, artifacts): Runs a single gate's scans. Returns GateResult.

scan_event_hooks.pre_scan: Verify identity_validated items only (Gate -1 passed). Load required artifacts. Check disk space for artifact storage.
scan_event_hooks.post_scan: Write scan artifacts. Update scan registry. Aggregate per-item verdicts.
scan_event_hooks.on_hard_fail: Route BLOCKED items to EditorialQueue. Exclude from subsequent gates. Generate HARD_FAIL report.
scan_event_hooks.on_soft_fail: Flag REMEDIATE items. Continue pipeline. Generate WARN report.

scans.description: Identity Validation — QID Presence, CorrectChoice Presence, Pack Attribution, TemplateFamily Constructibility. The mandatory pre-condition gate — no downstream scan result admissible until IDENTITY_VALID.

algorithm.step1_qid_validation: For each item: check item.QuestionID is non-empty string matching pack-specific regex. Pack A: /^P1-[A-F]-\d{3}$/. Pack B: /^P1B-[A-F]-\d{3}$/. Pack C: /^P1-[A-F]C?-\d{3}$/. Pack D: /^P1-[A-F]D-\d{3}$/. Pack E: /^P1E-[A-F]-\d{3}$/. Non-match → IDENTITY_BLOCKED: QID_INVALID_FORMAT.
algorithm.step2_cc_validation: For each item: check item.CorrectChoice is a single character in ['A','B','C','D']. Null/undefined/multi-char → IDENTITY_BLOCKED: CC_MISSING_OR_INVALID.
algorithm.step3_pack_attribution: For each item: verify item's file path matches its configured pack. Self-check: confirm QID format aligns with pack name (e.g., P1B- prefix items only appear in pack_b_corrected.js). Cross-pack collision scan: confirm no two items have identical QID in different pack files — actual collisions (not visual similarities per DL-033).
algorithm.step4_template_family: For each item: call TemplateFamilyClassifier. Items with >90% stem Jaccard → assign family ID. Items with <70% → STANDALONE. Items 70-90% → UNCLASSIFIED, IDENTITY_WARN.
algorithm.step5_compound_key: For each item: call IdentityKeyResolver.resolveIdentityKey(). Verify compound key is globally unique across all 5 packs.

input.items: Parsed question array from AM-1 Function Constructor

error_handling.AM1_parse_failure: Fallback to AM-2 string-aware parse. If AM-2 also fails → IDENTITY_FATAL for entire pack. Escalate to governance.
error_handling.QID_format_edge_case: Pack C mixed format (P1-BC-094 vs P1-AC-001): both patterns accepted. Regex allows optional 'C' suffix.

scans.description: JSON Integrity — Parseability, Required Field Presence, Type Consistency, Corruption Detection, QuestionID Count Verification. Failing this gate blocks the entire pipeline for affected files.

algorithm.step1_parse: Attempt AM-1 Function Constructor parse: `new Function(rawContent + '; return MCQ_BANK_{X};')()`. If error → attempt AM-2 string-aware brace-matched extraction object-by-object. If AM-2 also fails → HARD_FAIL: PARSE_FAILURE. Record line number range of failure.
algorithm.step2_field_presence: For each parsed object, verify all 10 required fields exist: QuestionID, Stem, Choices (or Choices.{A,B,C,D}), CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect, ExplanationWrongA, ExplanationWrongB, ExplanationWrongC, ExplanationWrongD. Missing field → HARD_FAIL: MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD. Record which field is missing.
algorithm.step3_type_consistency: Verify CorrectChoice is string ('A'-'D'). Verify ExplanationWrong fields are strings or 'undefined' (absent). Verify Choices is object with keys A-D or array. Type error → HARD_FAIL: TYPE_MISMATCH.
algorithm.step4_corruption_detect: Scan raw file content for known corruption patterns: DL-017 backtick-newline (`` `n `` regex), `,NNN: true,` artifact, unmatched braces, orphaned commas, duplicate QuestionIDs within same pack. Corruption → HARD_FAIL: CORRUPTION_DETECTED.
algorithm.step5_count_verification: Verify parse-count equals expected (Pack A:500, B:500, C:500, D:500, E:500). Cross-validate against grep count: `grep -c '"QuestionID"'` on raw file. Mismatch → HARD_FAIL: COUNT_MISMATCH.

input.expectedCount: Integer: expected item count for this pack

error_handling.parse_failure: HARD_FAIL entire pack file. Do NOT proceed to Gate 1 for any items in that pack. Generate PARSE_FAILURE report with file, line range, and raw error message.
error_handling.count_mismatch: HARD_FAIL. Pipeline halts for that pack until count reconciled. Possible causes: items added/removed, parse undercount (DL-020), file corruption (DL-017).

scans.description: ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] Non-Empty — EV8 violation. Highest-priority learner-safety defect.

algorithm.step1: For each item with ValidCC: cc = item.CorrectChoice.toUpperCase(); ewField = 'ExplanationWrong' + cc; ewVal = item[ewField];
algorithm.step2: If ewVal !== undefined && ewVal !== null && String(ewVal).trim().length > 0 → DL-008 VIOLATION.
algorithm.step3: Record: QuestionID, CorrectChoice, field name, value excerpt (first 100 chars), full length, question_state, Template_Family.
algorithm.step4_codetect: In same pass: if item[ewField] === undefined → DL-018 (absent CC field). For each non-CC letter L: if item['ExplanationWrong' + L] === '' → DL-026. These are recorded to separate output arrays.

input.items: Parsed question array (IDENTITY_VALID + JSON clean only)

scans.gold_standard_test: Pack B must return 0 DL-008. Any scanner returning >0 on Pack B is non-compliant per S725 §6.2 (CC-before-QID format previously caused DL-029 false positives).

scans.description: Correct-Answer Slot Must Be Empty — extends DL-008 detection to case-study items. Runs in same pass as PG-001 for MCQ items with zero additional runtime.

algorithm.mcq_path: PG-001 output is authoritative. PG-009 delegates to PG-001 for MCQs.
algorithm.case_path: For each case item: if item.Type is 'select' or 'multi', identify the correct-answer letter from item.Correct. Check if corresponding wrong-explanation field is non-empty. Case items use object-based explanation fields — adapt to case structure.

input.case_items: Parsed case item arrays from scored_cases*.js

scans.description: Empty or Absent Non-CorrectChoice ExplanationWrong Slots — unified detection of three defect classes in a single pass.

algorithm.step1: For each item with ValidCC: cc = item.CorrectChoice.toUpperCase();
algorithm.step2: For each letter L in ['A','B','C','D'] where L !== cc: if !(('ExplanationWrong' + L) in item) → DL-021 (field absent). elif item['ExplanationWrong' + L] === '' → DL-026 (empty string). elif item['ExplanationWrong' + L].length > 0 AND item['ExplanationWrong' + L].length < 50 → DL-026_SHORT (too short for educational value).
algorithm.step3_co_detect_dl008: If item['ExplanationWrong' + cc] is non-empty → flag separately in PG-001 output — chaining prevention: DL-026 remediation for an item with active DL-008 must clear DL-008 first.
algorithm.step4_record: For each violation: QuestionID, CorrectChoice, empty_slot, field_state (absent|empty|short), estimated_impact (Certified → learner sees no feedback), question_state.

input.items: Parsed question array (IDENTITY_VALID + JSON clean + non-BLOCKED from Gate 0)

scans.description: Metadata-Block vs Content-Block Choice Divergence — ChoiceA-D must match Choices.{A-D} for dual-block packs.

algorithm.step1_pack_architecture: Determine pack architecture: Pack A/C/D = dual-block (has both flat ChoiceA-D and nested Choices.{A-D}). Pack B/E = single-block (only nested Choices.{A-D}) — skip scan, return PASS.
algorithm.step2_field_extraction: For dual-block packs: from the SAME JSON object, extract choiceA = item.ChoiceA AND choicesA = item.Choices.A (same for B/C/D). These MUST come from the same brace-delimited object (AM-1 guarantee).
algorithm.step3_comparison: For each letter L: if normalize(choiceL) !== normalize(choicesL) → DL-016 VIOLATION. normalize() = trim + collapse_whitespace + lowercase.
algorithm.step4_ew_relevance_check: For items with DL-016: extract ExplanationWrong[A-D] text. Check if EW text topically relates to item's own Choices text or describes a different topic (DL-016 +1 shift symptom). If EW text mismatch → escalate to DL-016_SEVERE (learner-safety risk per G-NEW-2).
algorithm.step5_template_family_correlation: For items flagged DL-016: correlate with Template_Family. If all members of a family share the same shift offset → template-pipeline artifact (DL-016 root cause confirmed). If only some members → remediation artifact.

input.items: Parsed question array from dual-block packs only (A, C, D)

scans.note: Dual-block packs only (A/C/D). Single-block packs (B/E) skip with PASS — no metadata-content split exists.

scans.description: Template Boilerplate in ExplanationWrong Fields — dual-phrase detection plus Jaccard similarity analysis.

algorithm.step1_dual_phrase_detect: For each EW[A-D] field: test for presence of BOTH signature phrases: 'represents a plausible misconception' AND 'A candidate may select this option by misapplying'. If BOTH present → DL-013 Pattern A (standalone boilerplate). If one present but not both → DL-013 Pattern C (partial).
algorithm.step2_jaccard: For each item: compute Jaccard similarity between EW slot pairs (EW-A/B, EW-A/C, EW-A/D, EW-B/C, EW-B/D, EW-C/D). If any pair > 0.85 similarity → DL-013 Pattern B (high similarity — likely copy-paste boilerplate). If > 0.70 → DL-013 Pattern D (moderate — flagged for review).
algorithm.step3_closing_tag: Test for DL-027 closing tag: 'A candidate selecting this option may misunderstand how the governing standard applies to this specific fact pattern.' If present standalone (without Pattern A phrases) → DL-027 (closing-tag only — more benign).
algorithm.step4_certified_check: If item.question_state === 'Certified' AND any DL-013 pattern detected → escalate to DL-013_CERTIFIED (violates CAQS §4.3 EV2 placeholder-text rule on active learner-pool items).

scans.description: ExplanationCorrect References Accounting Principle By Name — checks for ASC, COSO, IAS, IFRS, GAAP, FASB, IMA, Sarbanes-Oxley, PCAOB, AICPA citations in ExplanationCorrect text.

algorithm.step1_regex: For each item: test ExplanationCorrect against citation regex library: /ASC\s*\d{3}(-\d{2}(-\d{2})?)?/i, /IAS\s*\d{1,2}/i, /IFRS\s*\d{1,2}/i, /\bCOSO\b/i, /\bGAAP\b/i, /\bFASB\b/i, /\bIMA\s+Statement\b/i, /\bSarbanes-Oxley\b/i, /\bSEC\b/i, /\bPCAOB\b/i, /\bAICPA\b/i.
algorithm.step2_cognitive_level_waiver: If item.CognitiveLevel is 'Remember' or 'Understand' → EV3 waived (definition-level items don't require standard citation). Skip.
algorithm.step3_principle_mention: Extended check: does EC mention any accounting principle by name (even without standard number)? Check for: 'matching principle', 'revenue recognition', 'lower of cost', 'net realizable value', 'historical cost', 'fair value', 'consistency', 'conservatism', 'materiality', 'full disclosure', 'going concern'.
algorithm.step4_citation_form: If citation found: verify citation format is plausible for the standard. ASC 210 for loss contingency → DL-009 cross-flag (wrong standard cited for topic). Requires cross-reference to known topic→standard map.

scans.description: Misassigned Choice Explanations — Tier 1 lexical overlap between EW text and choice text; Tier 2 numeric mismatch heuristic.

algorithm.step1_lexical_overlap: For each item, for each letter L: compute Jaccard similarity between EW[L] text and Choices[L] text. If similarity < 0.10 → DL-010 SUSPECT (explanation has near-zero lexical overlap with the choice it's supposed to describe).
algorithm.step2_cross_choice_best_match: For each slot L where similarity < 0.10: compute similarity of EW[L] against Choices[K] for all other K. If EW[L] has higher similarity to Choices[K] (K ≠ L) than to Choices[L] → DL-010 HIGH (explanation better matches a different choice).
algorithm.step3_numeric_mismatch: For calculation items: extract numbers from EW text and compare to numbers in Choices text. If EW describes $16,160 but choice text is $80,800 → DL-010 NUMERIC (strong evidence of misassignment).
algorithm.step4_fp_risk: Automated DL-010 detection has ~94% false-positive risk (threshold-based lexical overlap is poor signal). This scan is advisory — outputs are WARN only, never HARD_BLOCK. Requires human editorial review to confirm.

scans.description: CorrectChoice Answer-Key Verification — independently re-derives correct answer from stem + choices and compares to stored CorrectChoice. Detects CC answer-key errors.

algorithm.step1_calculation_items: For items where CalculationRequired === true: extract all numeric values from stem. Derive correct answer using formula reference. Compare to stored CC's choice text. If mismatch → DL-030 NUMERIC.
algorithm.step2_conceptual_items: For conceptual items: verify CC is defensible as correct based on stem text. Flag any item where the CC choice directly contradicts an accounting standard cited in the stem or EC.
algorithm.step3_confidence_flagging: AI-derived verification is advisory. Each finding carries a confidence score (0-100). HIGH confidence (>90) → DL-030 CONFIRMED. MEDIUM confidence (70-90) → DL-030 SUSPECT, flagged for human review. LOW confidence (<70) → not flagged — defer to full Quality Board review.
algorithm.step4_certified_priority: Certified items with DL-030 CONFIRMED → critical learner-safety risk. Wrong answer marked correct in active delivery pool.

scans.note: Heaviest scan — requires AI-powered independent re-derivation. May take 30s+ for all 2,500 items. Consider incremental approach: recheck only items with content_hash change since last verification.

scans.description: Difficulty Calibration — Definition-Match Inflation Detection. Flags items labeled Moderate or higher that test only Bloom's Remember/Understand.

algorithm.step1_definition_match: For each item: compute lexical overlap between stem and the correct answer choice text (Jaccard > 0.50 suggests definition-match).
algorithm.step2_cognitive_demand: If definition-match detected AND item.DifficultyScore >= 3 (Moderate+) AND item.CognitiveLevel is 'Remember' or 'Understand' → DL-031 INFLATED. The item tests definition recall but is labeled as requiring application/analysis.
algorithm.step3_all_of_the_above: Special case: correct answer is 'All of the above' where all sub-choices are definitionally correct. This is a recognition task, not analysis. Auto-flag as DL-031 if DifficultyScore >= 3.
algorithm.step4_distractor_sophistication: Retroactive check: if distractors are genuinely sophisticated (require application-level discernment despite definition-like stem), the Moderate label may be justified. Flag for human review rather than auto-recalibrating.

scans.description: Choice Position Balance Analysis — verifies correct answer distribution across A/B/C/D, checks for running patterns, sequential dependence, and position bias.

algorithm.per_section: Compute CC distribution percentage per section. Expected: 22-28% per position. Flag sections deviating >5% from 25%.
algorithm.running_patterns: Detect streaks of same CC > 4 consecutive items. Flag as POSITION_STREAK.
algorithm.sequential_dependence: For each section: compute P(next_CC | current_CC). If any conditional probability > 0.40 → POSITION_PATTERN (CC predictable from prior item).
algorithm.pack_level: Compute overall A/B/C/D distribution per pack. Flag packs with >30% in any single position.

scans.description: Metadata Completeness Audit — verifies all required metadata fields are present per QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD.md.

algorithm.for each item: Check presence of each required field. Flag missing fields.
Check presence of recommended fields. Report completion percentage.

scans.description: Certification Eligibility Assessment — evaluates which items are eligible for certification (all gates passed, no HARD_BLOCK defects).

algorithm.for each item: Aggregate all gate verdicts. If all gates PASS → CERTIFIABLE. If any HARD_BLOCK → NOT_CERTIFIABLE. If only WARN/SOFT_BLOCK → CERTIFIABLE_WITH_WARNINGS.
algorithm.by_pack: Compute certification-eligible counts per pack. Identify largest blocks of non-eligible items.
algorithm.by_defect: Compute which defect classes block the most items from certification.

scans.description: Difficulty Distribution Analysis — verifies pool-wide difficulty distribution meets CAQS §6.1 targets.

algorithm.actual: Compute pool-wide difficulty distribution. Compare to CAQS targets.
algorithm.by_section: Compute per-section difficulty distribution. Flag sections with zero difficulty variance (all Moderate — DL-032 pattern).
algorithm.gap_analysis: Identify which specific difficulty tiers need more items to meet CAQS targets.

Gate_-1.requires: Raw pack file content + Function constructor parse capability
Gate_-1.blocks_if_fail: All downstream gates for IDENTITY_BLOCKED items

Gate_0.blocks_if_fail: All downstream gates for that pack (unparseable file)

Gate_1.requires: Gate_0 parsed object arrays + Gate_-1 IDENTITY_VALID flag
Gate_1.scans_parallel: PG-001, PG-005, PG-004 can run in parallel on same item set
Gate_1.blocks_if_fail: HARD_BLOCK items excluded from Gate_2+ processing

Gate_2.scans_parallel: PG-003, PG-008, PG-002 can run in parallel

Gate_3.requires: Gate_0-2 processed items + compound keys from Gate_-1 + Template_Family assignments

Gate_4.scans_parallel: PG-006, PG-007 can run in parallel

scan_depends_on_scan.PG-001 depends on PG-011: Requires IDENTITY_VALID items with confirmed CorrectChoice from within-object extraction
scan_depends_on_scan.PG-005 depends on PG-001: PG-005's DL-026 detection shares the same CorrectChoice→EW[CC] check. If PG-001 DETECTS DL-008 on an item, PG-005 should flag that item as 'dl008_co_present' and warn: 'Clear DL-008 before DL-026 remediation.'
scan_depends_on_scan.PG-004 depends on PG-011: Requires Template_Family from identity resolution to correlate DL-016 with rotation artifacts
scan_depends_on_scan.PG-006 depends on PG-001: DL-030 CC verification must operate on the same CC value that PG-001 used for DL-008 detection. If CC is wrong due to DL-016, PG-006's independent re-derivation will flag it.

artifact_storage.retention: All scan artifacts retained through active phase (S202-S910). Archived to reports/legacy/scans/ after S910.

error_handling_standard.am1_failure: If Function constructor parse fails for any scan → fall back to AM-2 string-aware parse. If AM-2 also fails → record SCAN_ERROR with file+line_range+raw_error. Do NOT silently return empty results.
error_handling_standard.qid_list_mandatory: All violation outputs MUST include per-QID list. Totals-only output is PROHIBITED per FM-005. Any scan producing totals without QID list is rejected.
error_handling_standard.count_stability: Before accepting any count, run scan twice with identical methodology. Compare counts between runs. If mismatch → investigate scanner methodology (DL-020 brace-matcher string-awareness gap, or forward-scan CC-offset). Do not accept unstable counts.
error_handling_standard.idempotency: All scans must be idempotent — running the same scan twice on the same input produces identical output (same QID lists, same counts, same verdicts). Non-idempotent scans indicate methodology bugs.

implementation_notes.scanner_shared_library: All scans share a common extraction library: `scripts/engine/scans/lib/scanner_shared.js`. Provides: withinObjectExtract(), computeJaccard(), normalizeText(), stripProperNouns(), regexLibrary, fieldPresenceCheck().
implementation_notes.governance_guard_integration: Scans PG-001 through PG-010 produce artifact files. governance-guard.js Rules 6-8 read these artifacts at session T0/Tmid/Tend to enforce pre-flight gating.
implementation_notes.delta_review_integration: DeltaReviewEngine queries scan artifacts to determine if unchanged items (content_hash match) have new scan findings. If Gate 1 scan on unchanged item detects DL-026 that wasn't present in prior scan → item flagged for review despite hash match.
